title_sq: Tek Kafe Flora, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1 Me Lokacion & Orientim Perfekt!!!

title_en: At Kafe Flora, Super Apartment 2+1 For Sale With Perfect Location & Orientation!!!
description_en: Very close to the city center, at Cafe Flora, for sale Super Apartment 2+1+Kitchen, with great orientation and location!!! The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of an existing building with a net area of ​​103 m2 and is organized in a spacious corridor that distributes through the other rooms, starting with the living room, the kitchen which is separate and has access to the balcony. Two spacious rooms, a bathroom with window, a storage room and two balconies. The orientation is from South-East and West, which means that there is natural light and sun throughout the day. The area where it is located is quite preferred both for residence and for investment, being very close to the center and the rental values ​​in this area are high. It has every possible facility such as nurseries, kindergartens, schools and any other service. The environment has recently been invested: parquet flooring, air conditioning, plumbing and electrical installations. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation.
